SP Rajya Sabha Candidate Praises PM Modi, Angers Party Chief

Dhanraj Nathwani, a Rajya Sabha candidate nominated by the Samajwadi Party (SP), publicly praised Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This action reportedly caused distress to SP chief Akhilesh Yadav. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has supported Nathwani's praise of Modi, with one statement suggesting that even Akhilesh Yadav secretly admires the Prime Minister.
